title: Andalusian Chickpea Tapas
description: A hearty and flavorful tapas dish from Andalusia, Spain, featuring rich and slow-cooked chickpeas.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chickpeas, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chickpeas are tender.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
